stem: Which statement best reflects balanced macronutrient nutrition?
choices: Plant performance depends on interacting supplies of multiple essential elements rather than maximizing one element in isolation
Nitrogen concentration is usually the strongest single predictor, so other macronutrients can be interpreted after nitrogen is optimized
A phosphorus increase can offset several other macronutrient shortages because phosphorus controls most nutrient-use efficiency
Potassium can be evaluated independently because its concentration has little practical relationship to the balance of other mineral nutrients
rationale: Macronutrients perform different physiological roles and interact in plant nutrition. Sound interpretation considers balance and developmental context rather than maximizing one element independently.
